stores.name: A Letshego Fashion House
stores.tagline: Fitting, altering and styling
stores.story: A fashion house with a full tailoring bench behind it. Bring the outfit, they will fit it to you while you wait.
stores.return_policy: 14 days with tags, exchange only.
stores.delivery_promise: Alterations same day if you drop before 11:00.

stores.name: Bitwise Computing & Gaming
stores.tagline: Builds, fixes and game rooms
stores.story: Bitwise builds custom gaming rigs and office machines, and runs a bench where customers can bring their own tower in to be diagnosed in front of them. The Gaborone esports team trains in the arcade room at the back.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on complete systems. Build-to-order parts are non-returnable.
stores.delivery_promise: Full PC setup and game install, delivered and working.

stores.name: Bonwadi Fresh Market
stores.tagline: Picked in the morning, on the shelf by seven
stores.story: Bonwadi has served Kgale since 1998. The produce arrives from the Jamestown farms before dawn and the butchery counter opens the same morning. Naledi runs the floor and will always tell you which veg is going off tonight for half price.
stores.return_policy: Unopened fresh produce refunded or replaced within 24 hours, no questions.
stores.delivery_promise: Delivered within 90 minutes across Kgale and Gaborone West.

stores.name: Boro & Sons Butchery
stores.tagline: Hung beef, cut to order
stores.story: Three generations of butchers. The chiller runs from 04:00 and the beef is aged properly before it is cut, which is why regulars order by phone and collect at seven.
stores.return_policy: Refunded at the counter for any cut you did not order.
stores.delivery_promise: Pre-ordered cuts ready for collection from 07:00.

stores.name: Boshweu Fashion
stores.tagline: Clothes that fit the shift roster
stores.story: Ready-made clothing and shoes for a town that works shifts. The fitting room is real, and the alterations bench is quicker than the shop next door.
stores.return_policy: 14 days with tags, exchange only.
stores.delivery_promise: Delivered to the hostels and the mine offices.

stores.name: BuildRight Hardware
stores.tagline: If it bolts, we have it — and we will help you fit it
stores.story: BuildRight has served Tlokweng builders for fifteen years. The team will identify a fitting from a photo, and the store stocks pipe, paint and power tool consumables so a job does not stop on a Tuesday.
stores.return_policy: Unused hardware returned within 14 days. Power tools 6 months, boxed.
stores.delivery_promise: Trade delivery to site within 24 hours anywhere in Gaborone.

stores.name: Camelthorn Naturals
stores.tagline: Shea, camelthorn oil and clean skin
stores.story: A women-run skincare house that presses shea from the Mooke and Ntwetwe cooperatives. Everything is made in small batches in Serowe, and the labels say exactly where the butter came from.
stores.return_policy: 30 days, unopened.
stores.delivery_promise: Posted within 48 hours anywhere in Botswana.

stores.name: Charged Accessories
stores.tagline: The cable you lost, without the trip to the mall
stores.story: Charged keeps deep stock of the small things — cables, chargers, cases, power banks — because waiting for a small part is a waste of an afternoon. If it is in the catalogue, it is on the shelf in Motswedi today.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on unopened accessories, 30 days on power banks.
stores.delivery_promise: Rider dispatch within 45 minutes across Gaborone.

stores.name: Chobe Safari Lodge Shop
stores.tagline: Guest-facing supply, lodge delivery
stores.story: The supply shop behind the lodge counter. It stocks what guests buy at the last minute and what the lodges themselves need weekly.
stores.address: Chobe Safari Lodge, Kazungula Road, Kasane
stores.return_policy: 7 days on unused gear.
stores.delivery_promise: Delivered to the lodges around Kasane the same day.

stores.name: Dazzle Beauty & Health
stores.tagline: Skincare, hair and pharmacy, by people who use it
stores.story: Dazzle began as a single make-up counter in the Village and now stocks skin, hair and everyday pharmacy lines. The team is trained to read your skin, not just to sell you something.
stores.return_policy: Unopened beauty and pharmacy items refundable within 14 days with receipt.
stores.delivery_promise: Discreet delivery, in a sealed bag, within two hours in Gaborone Central.

stores.name: Delta Safari Outfitters
stores.tagline: Field kit for a hard season
stores.story: Outfitters and guides who know what the bush actually asks for. Everything on the wall has been carried, slept in and repaired by the people who sell it.
stores.address: Shop 2, Maun Safari Centre, Boro River Road
stores.return_policy: 30 days on unused field gear.
stores.delivery_promise: Camp drop in the Okavango reserve within 2 hours of Maun.

stores.name: Francistown Junction Hub
stores.tagline: The copper town meets the network
stores.story: The Francistown hub opened the year the Junction went national. It anchors the Tati and Zambezi end of the platform, moving copper-country hardware, fresh produce and mining consumables north to the Zambezi, and consumer goods back down the line.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on goods in original condition unless marked final sale.
stores.delivery_promise: Orders placed before 12:00 leave Francistown the same working day.

stores.name: Gaborone Sun Mart
stores.tagline: Every staple, every week, at a fair price
stores.story: A family-run supermarket on the Gaborone West side of the mall. Mole and kgotlwana shoppers have bought their maize meal and cooking oil here for two decades. The store keeps deep stock on the staples so nobody is told "come back tomorrow".
stores.return_policy: Unopened pantry goods returned within 7 days with receipt.
stores.delivery_promise: Same-day delivery in Gaborone West, Kgale and Extension 10.

stores.name: Ghanzi Beef Co.
stores.tagline: Cattle country on the counter
stores.story: A butchery that works directly with four ranches. The beef is dry-aged in the walk-in, and the biltong is made in the back room with the recipe unchanged for thirty years.
stores.address: Shop 3, Ghanzi Butchery Complex, Market Street
stores.return_policy: Refunded on the day for anything off.
stores.delivery_promise: Bulk orders to the ranches on the weekly cattle run.

stores.name: Ghanzi Cattle Country Hub
stores.tagline: Beef country, on the platform
stores.story: Ghanzi is cattle country and the hub trades like it: beef, outdoor gear and the deep stocks of a place where the next shop is two hundred kilometres away.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on goods in original condition unless marked final sale.
stores.delivery_promise: Orders placed before 12:00 leave Ghanzi the same working day.

stores.name: Home by the Lake
stores.tagline: Cookware, bedding and a working kitchen
stores.story: A homeware shop that caters to the apartments and letting houses that fill up every year with students and contract workers.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on unused homeware.
stores.delivery_promise: Same-day delivery in Palapye, next day to Serowe and Kanye.

stores.name: Kabelo Bags & Accessories
stores.tagline: Bags, belts, hats and the small things that finish it
stores.story: Kabelo packs for the office, the market and the airport. Everything is sourced from Botswana and South African makers, and the team will adjust a strap on the spot.
stores.return_policy: Unused and in the original bag, 21 days.
stores.delivery_promise: Same-day delivery in Gaborone North, Phakalane and Village.
stores.sections: [{"title":"Kabelo’s carry picks","kind":"staff"},{"title":"Travel and commute","kind":"travel"},{"title":"Small leather goods","kind":"goods"}]

stores.name: Kalahari Trading Post
stores.tagline: Deep stock for deep distances
stores.story: General and outdoor supply. They hold cold-chain spares, 4x4 accessories and enough water and food to fill a convoy.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on unused camping gear.
stores.delivery_promise: Convoy loads delivered to the gate, on the road day.

stores.name: Kalaka Textiles
stores.tagline: Fabric, cut and sewn
stores.story: Fabric, sewing machines and a tailoring service that will copy anything you bring in. The traditional wedding orders are the busiest week of the year.
stores.return_policy: Alterations redone free within 14 days.
stores.delivery_promise: Made-to-measure order ready in five working days.

stores.name: Kanye Community Market
stores.tagline: Staples for the southern corridor
stores.story: The market has been the first and last shop in Kanye for thirty years. It buys maize in bulk at harvest and sells it through the lean months, which is why its prices hold when others climb.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on unopened staples with a receipt.
stores.delivery_promise: Delivered to villages within 60km on the Thursday round.

stores.name: Kanye Junction Hub
stores.tagline: The last full stop before the highway
stores.story: Kanye is the last full stop before the long run to the south. The hub holds the staples, the hardware and the crafts that the whole southern corridor buys on one trip.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on goods in original condition unless marked final sale.
stores.delivery_promise: Orders placed before 12:00 leave Kanye the same working day.

stores.name: Karabo Gems & Gifts
stores.tagline: Gold, beads and gifts worth giving
stores.story: Karabo is a family jeweller in Gaborone Central with its own workshop behind the counter. Gold is bought and sold on the day, and the workshop will size a ring while you wait.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on unworn items with the certificate. Gold bought back at the day’s rate.
stores.delivery_promise: Free insured delivery in Gaborone Central on the same day.

stores.name: Kasane River Gate Hub
stores.tagline: Where the road meets the Chobe
stores.story: Kasane is the far end of the northern line, and the most expensive freight in the country to serve. The hub is small, focused and honest about what it can hold.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on goods in original condition unless marked final sale.
stores.delivery_promise: Orders placed before 12:00 leave Kasane the same working day.

stores.name: Kasane Riverside Curios
stores.tagline: Beads, wood and river craft
stores.story: A craft shop whose stock comes from the Kavango river communities and the Zambezi floodplain. Every piece names the maker.
stores.return_policy: Exchange within 7 days for unused items.
stores.delivery_promise: Wrapped and couriered anywhere in Botswana within 72 hours.

stores.name: Kgatleng Agro Centre
stores.tagline: Feed, fence and tillage for the district
stores.story: A working agro dealer that keeps stock of the things farmers actually need on the day, and knows which boreholes the crops need. Maize feed is milled to order for the cattle posts.
stores.return_policy: 7 days on tools. Feed and fertiliser are not returnable.
stores.delivery_promise: Delivered to cattle posts within 40km of Lobatse on farm day.

stores.name: Kgatleng Poultry
stores.tagline: Chicks, feed and advice that works
stores.story: Poultry and garden suppliers. The chicks arrive on the Tuesday run and the feed is milled in Mochudi, which keeps the freight cost — and the price — down.
stores.return_policy: Live animals: health guarantee of 7 days with the supplier.
stores.delivery_promise: Feed delivered to the kraal, not the gate.

stores.name: Kopana Household Depot
stores.tagline: Cleaning, tissue and the monthly refill
stores.story: Kopana sells in bulk because that is how Gaborone households shop — a two-kilo powder, a six-pack of tissue, a refill of dishwashing liquid. Refill pricing is automatic once you have an account with the shop.
stores.return_policy: Opened cleaning product cannot be returned. Sealed items, 14 days.
stores.delivery_promise: Refill routes run every morning to Gaborone North and Ramokgwebana.

stores.name: Kruger's Bakery & Deli
stores.tagline: Out of the oven at five, on the counter at seven
stores.story: Pieter and Boitumelo Kruger have baked in Block B since 2011. The koeksisters go out first, then the loaves, then the pies. Everything is made in the back room you can see through the glass.
stores.address: Unit 7, Block B Shopping Centre, Gaborone
stores.return_policy: Baked goods cannot be returned, but we will always replace anything that arrives broken.
stores.delivery_promise: Morning delivery — order before 10:00 for same-day loaves.

stores.name: Letlhakeng Food Store
stores.tagline: The pantry for the whole western corridor
stores.story: A store built for distance: it buys deep, keeps the shelf full between deliveries and knows which route is open when the road is cut by water.
stores.return_policy: 7 days on unopened food items.
stores.delivery_promise: Weekly road delivery to outlying posts, on the road day.

stores.name: Letlhakeng Junction Hub
stores.tagline: Past the cattle posts, on the road to Jwaneng
stores.story: Letlhakeng sits where the highway narrows. The hub stocks the everyday, plus the fabric and tailoring that the western corridor buys in bulk.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on goods in original condition unless marked final sale.
stores.delivery_promise: Orders placed before 12:00 leave Letlhakeng the same working day.

stores.name: Lobatse Bakehouse
stores.tagline: Bread out of the oven at 05:00
stores.story: A bakehouse that has fed Lobatse since 1996. The bread comes out at five, the pies at six, and the celebration cakes are iced in the afternoon for the weekend.
stores.return_policy: Refound on the day of purchase with the receipt.
stores.delivery_promise: Hot bread on the Lobatse round every morning at 08:00.

stores.name: Lobatse Crossroads Hub
stores.tagline: Where the highway stops for fuel
stores.story: Lobatse is the junction on the road, so its hub is built around what the road needs: agro supplies that farmers collect in a truck, hardware for the building trade, and food that arrives from Gaborone twice a week.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on goods in original condition unless marked final sale.
stores.delivery_promise: Orders placed before 12:00 leave Lobatse the same working day.

stores.name: Mahalapye Food Hall
stores.tagline: Fill the boot, not the basket
stores.story: Built for families doing a monthly shop, the food hall stocks in bulk and prices in bulk. The maize is milled at the back every week.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on unopened dry goods.
stores.delivery_promise: Home delivery in Mahalapye from P150, same day.

stores.name: Mahalapye Junction Hub
stores.tagline: The A1 at the foot of the hills
stores.story: Mahalapye sits where the A1 starts to climb. The hub serves the corridor north and south, with a stock of hardware, beverages and car parts that the highway stops are too small to carry.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on goods in original condition unless marked final sale.
stores.delivery_promise: Orders placed before 12:00 leave Mahalapye the same working day.

stores.name: Makgadikgadi Camping
stores.tagline: Shade, chairs and cold beer
stores.story: Camping supply and hire for the pan camps, with a generator and a fridge for anyone who wants both.
stores.address: Stand 4, Nata Gate Market, A2 Highway
stores.return_policy: 7 days on hire items in good order.
stores.delivery_promise: Camp set-up service for self-drives within 40km.

stores.name: Makgadikgadi Outdoor Hire
stores.tagline: Gear for the pans and the delta
stores.story: Camping and 4x4 equipment hire and sale. The pans are seasonal, the bookings are not, and everything is checked after every hire.
stores.return_policy: 7 days on hire items in good order.
stores.delivery_promise: Gear delivered to your camp within 40km of Tsabong.

stores.name: Maun Gateway Hub
stores.tagline: The gateway to the delta
stores.story: Maun is the last supply point before the delta, and the hub is built for it: camping gear, fishing tackle, fuel and cold boxes that survive a forty-degree afternoon.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on goods in original condition unless marked final sale.
stores.delivery_promise: Orders placed before 12:00 leave Maun the same working day.

stores.name: Maun Trading Co.
stores.tagline: Household, fuel and dry stores
stores.story: The deep-shelf trading house that keeps Maun supplied between the weekly road loads. Fuel, water and household in one stop, which is how the town has always shopped.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on unopened household goods.
stores.delivery_promise: Free delivery in Maun on orders over P300.

stores.name: Metsi Home Store
stores.tagline: The whole kitchen, from a pot to a plate
stores.story: Extension 10 is where Gaborone families furnish their first homes, and Metsi has been there since 2014. The store carries everything for a working kitchen — and the team will talk you through a pressure cooker the way a family member would.
stores.return_policy: 30-day returns on unused homeware with original packaging.
stores.delivery_promise: Heavy items delivered and unpacked to the door, free over P500.

stores.name: Mochudi Village Hub
stores.tagline: Village trading, on the Junction
stores.story: Mochudi is a village of traders, not a suburb of Gaborone. The hub gives those traders a digital counter, and gives the village the same Land Local pricing the capital has.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on goods in original condition unless marked final sale.
stores.delivery_promise: Orders placed before 12:00 leave Mochudi the same working day.

stores.name: Mochudi Village Market
stores.tagline: The village shop, with a national shelf
stores.story: A family shop that started with a single shelf of maize and now lists everything the Junction can deliver, from a phone to a mattress.
stores.return_policy: 7 days on unopened household goods.
stores.delivery_promise: Free village delivery on orders over P200 within Mochudi.

stores.name: Mogoditshane Fresh Mart
stores.tagline: Fast, cheap and open late
stores.story: A neighbourhood mart that stays open until nine and prices to the week. It is the most-bought shop on the platform in this township.
stores.return_policy: 7 days on unopened goods.
stores.delivery_promise: Free delivery in the township on orders over P150.

stores.name: Mogoditshane Junction Hub
stores.tagline: The township joins the network
stores.story: Mogoditshane is where the city and the village meet. The hub serves a dense, young, cash-and-delivery market that had no platform of its own.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on goods in original condition unless marked final sale.
stores.delivery_promise: Orders placed before 12:00 leave Mogoditshane the same working day.

stores.name: Morua Junction Hub — Gaborone West
stores.tagline: The courtyard: collect here, or we come to you
stores.story: The Hub is not a shop. It is Morua Junction’s own counter in Gaborone West, where you can collect an order from any shop in the mall, drop a return, or talk to a human about a delivery that went sideways.
stores.address: Morua Junction Hub, Stand 1, Gaborone West Mall, Gaborone
stores.return_policy: Returns accepted for any shop in the mall, even when you collected elsewhere.
stores.delivery_promise: Collect at the Hub in under 20 minutes, or have it delivered the same afternoon.

stores.name: Nata Gate Hub
stores.tagline: The salt-pan gate
stores.story: Nata is the gate to the Makgadikgadi and the road to the pans. The hub carries provisions, fuel and camp kit for the people who stop and the people who go through.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on goods in original condition unless marked final sale.
stores.delivery_promise: Orders placed before 12:00 leave Nata the same working day.

stores.name: Nata Provisions
stores.tagline: Everything for the long road
stores.story: A roadside provision shop that stocks deep, because the next one is a long way off and the road is not always open.
stores.return_policy: 7 days on unopened provisions.
stores.delivery_promise: Fuel bowser to camps within 50km by arrangement.

stores.name: Northline Mobile World
stores.tagline: Handsets, data and repairs north of the line
stores.story: Northline sells the phones and does the repairs. Their workshop fixes screens and boards while you wait, and their data desk knows which bundle is actually worth your money.
stores.return_policy: 7 days on handsets, 30 days on accessories.
stores.delivery_promise: Handset delivered and set up, with your data migrated.

stores.name: Okavango Angler
stores.tagline: Tackle for the lagoon and the channels
stores.story: A tackle shop that rigs and tests its own lures. The summer tiger-fish season empties the shelves by August, and the deep channels get the serious rods.
stores.return_policy: 7 days on unused tackle.
stores.delivery_promise: Live bait run every morning to the lodges around Maun.

stores.name: Palapye Lakeside Hub
stores.tagline: Lakeside, loud and busy
stores.story: Palapye grew fast and the shops came with it. The hub gives the lakeside its own pavilion: real hardware, real butchery and a food supply that does not run out on Friday.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on goods in original condition unless marked final sale.
stores.delivery_promise: Orders placed before 12:00 leave Palapye the same working day.

stores.name: Palapye Lakeside Market
stores.tagline: Lakeside at full volume
stores.story: A busy market that moved to the Lakeside footprint and kept its trade. Traders at the back sell directly from the loads that come in on the weekly road.
stores.return_policy: Same-day refund for anything not fresh.
stores.delivery_promise: Delivery across Palapye within the hour, flat P25.

stores.name: Phikwe Food Emporium
stores.tagline: A full shop in a mining town
stores.story: The emporium was rebuilt after the closure years and stocked better than before. Deep stock, fair prices and a delivery van that runs to the mine hostels.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on unopened goods.
stores.delivery_promise: Free delivery to the mine hostels on Thursdays.

stores.name: Phokoje Mining & Industrial
stores.tagline: Consumables that arrive before the shift ends
stores.story: A family supply house that has dressed the copper belt for two generations. It stocks PPE, welding consumables and workshop sundries, and it understands that a stopped crusher costs more than a delayed delivery.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on unused PPE. Safety gear is not returnable once tagged.
stores.delivery_promise: Ordered before 14:00, on site in Francistown the same afternoon.

stores.name: Pula Motor Spares
stores.tagline: Filters, brakes and the right tyre size
stores.story: A spares shop that stocks the parts for the vehicles that actually stop here — the Fortuner going north, the bakkie going to the cattle posts, the taxi doing the A1 loop.
stores.address: Unit 9, Mahalapye Auto Spares, Bypass Road
stores.return_policy: 14 days on unused parts, fitment guaranteed.
stores.delivery_promise: Fitted while you wait, or delivered to the yard the same day.

stores.name: Selebi Phikwe Hub
stores.tagline: The copper town that stayed
stores.story: Selebi Phikwe is a mining town that rebuilt itself. The hub serves the local trade, the mine supply and the families who stayed.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on goods in original condition unless marked final sale.
stores.delivery_promise: Orders placed before 12:00 leave Selebi Phikwe the same working day.

stores.name: Serowe Central Hub
stores.tagline: The square at the centre of Botswana
stores.story: Serowe is the geometric centre of the country, and the hub serves the cattle country around it — farm supplies in, fresh food out, and the specialist shops the corridor has always lacked.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on goods in original condition unless marked final sale.
stores.delivery_promise: Orders placed before 12:00 leave Serowe the same working day.

stores.name: Serowe Fresh Foods
stores.tagline: Butchery and produce from Serowe farms
stores.story: The butchery buys direct and hangs the beef properly, which is why the queue is there by seven. The vegetable side comes from the fields around Mmegi.
stores.address: Stand 7, Serowe Fresh Market, Main Street
stores.return_policy: Refund on the day for anything not to your liking.
stores.delivery_promise: Butchery delivery inside Serowe the same morning.

stores.name: Seshegue Bakehouse
stores.tagline: Baked through the night
stores.story: A bakehouse that starts at two in the morning so the bread is on the shelf by six, and the kgatekga is worth the early alarm.
stores.return_policy: Refound on the day with the receipt.
stores.delivery_promise: On the Tlokweng morning round by 08:00.

stores.name: Setswana Cellar & Pantry
stores.tagline: Local labels, cold fridges, and no import markup
stores.story: A drinks specialist in Gaborone Central with a deep cellar of Mosi-oa-Tunya, Thlou and Castle. Because the beer is bottled in Gaborone, it costs a fraction of what the same bottle costs in Sandton — and it is already cold.
stores.return_policy: Unopened bottles refundable within 7 days. No returns on opened product.
stores.delivery_promise: Cold-chain delivery in Gaborone Central and Block B, within 60 minutes.
stores.sections: [{"title":"Cold from the cellar","kind":"special"},{"title":"Local brews","kind":"local"},{"title":"Soft drinks and water","kind":"soft"}]

stores.name: Setswana Heritage Crafts
stores.tagline: Weaving, wood and beadwork from the corridor
stores.story: A craft co-operative of forty weavers and carvers. Their makalani cloth, woven on a pull-push loom, is sold across Botswana now, but the price floor is set here, by the people who make it.
stores.return_policy: Exchange within 7 days for unworn craft items.
stores.delivery_promise: Wrapped and couriered anywhere in Botswana within 48 hours.

stores.name: Soundwave Audio & TV
stores.tagline: Sound you can hear from the car park
stores.story: Soundwave is the specialist in Block B for speakers, soundbars and screens. The listening room at the back is open to anyone — bring a track, play it, decide in the room.
stores.address: Unit 12, Block B Shopping Centre, Gaborone
stores.return_policy: 14 days on audio gear. Screens are collected for a free 7-day dead-pixel check.
stores.delivery_promise: Free setup with any home delivery in Gaborone.

stores.name: Southern Hardware
stores.tagline: Paint, cement and the right drill bit
stores.story: A hardware counter run by people who have built things themselves. The advice is free and specific, and the cement is stored under cover because it should be.
stores.return_policy: 30 days on tools, 7 days on paint and consumables.
stores.delivery_promise: Same-day within Kanye, next day to the outlying posts.

stores.name: Tati Fresh Market
stores.tagline: Produce from the farms either side of the A1
stores.story: Tati Fresh Market buys directly from the farms along the Tati and the botiki plots outside Mahalapye. It has been trading since 1998 and still prices by the crate, not the marketing poster.
stores.return_policy: Refund or replace on the day of collection for anything not fresh.
stores.delivery_promise: Same-day delivery across Francistown, same price as the stand.

stores.name: Tau Shoes & Leather
stores.tagline: Good leather, resoled not replaced
stores.story: Tau repairs and re-soles rather than pushes replacements. A good pair of boots from Tau is expected to last a decade, and the shop will resole them when they finally give up.
stores.return_policy: Unworn, 14 days. Free first resole within six months.
stores.delivery_promise: Delivered with a shoe bag, free with any order over P400.

stores.name: Techno Village Gaborone
stores.tagline: Handsets, data and a human who answers
stores.story: Techno Village is the Gaborone place people bring their phones when something breaks. The team does activations, data bundles, transfers and screen repairs from one counter, and the phone you order is the phone that is on the shelf.
stores.return_policy: 7 days on handsets with the box and the receipt. Screen repair, 30 days.
stores.delivery_promise: Handsets delivered, set up and data transferred, within 2 hours in Central.
stores.sections: [{"title":"Thabang’s repairs bench","kind":"service"},{"title":"On offer this week","kind":"special"},{"title":"Data and bundles","kind":"data"}]

stores.name: Tlokweng General Store
stores.tagline: The village general store, national range
stores.story: A general store that stocks staples, and now the entire Junction catalogue alongside them.
stores.return_policy: 7 days on unopened goods.
stores.delivery_promise: Same-day delivery in Tlokweng and the surrounding posts.

stores.name: Tlokweng Junction Hub
stores.tagline: North-west of the capital, on the same shelf
stores.story: Tlokweng sits twenty minutes from the capital and a world away from its prices. The hub gives it the same product, the same pricing engine and the same delivery promise.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on goods in original condition unless marked final sale.
stores.delivery_promise: Orders placed before 12:00 leave Tlokweng the same working day.

stores.name: Tsabong General Trading
stores.tagline: Everything the road asked for
stores.story: A general dealer with a fuel bowser and a workshop behind it. If a vehicle breaks between Tsabong and the border, this is where the recovery comes from.
stores.return_policy: 7 days on unused parts.
stores.delivery_promise: Fuel bowser delivery to camps within 60km by arrangement.

stores.name: Tsabong Waypoint Hub
stores.tagline: Provisions, fuel and camp gear for the road west
stores.story: Tsabong is a waypoint. The hub stocks what a road needs: fuel, food, spares and the camping gear that the self-drives through the salt pans come to buy.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on goods in original condition unless marked final sale.
stores.delivery_promise: Orders placed before 12:00 leave Tsabong the same working day.

stores.name: Tshepo Fashion House
stores.tagline: Local tailoring under local labels
stores.story: Tshepo was founded by a tailor who wanted Gaborone to wear clothes made in Gaborone. The house runs its own atelier in Kgale, so a hem can be turned in a day and a size altered before the weekend.
stores.return_policy: Unworn with tags, 14 days. Free alteration within 7 days.
stores.delivery_promise: Alterations collected and returned by the same rider.

stores.name: Tsumeb Copper Supply
stores.tagline: For the pits and the workshops
stores.story: A supplier that came back with the town. It stocks PPE, welding consumables and the workshop items that the mine and the contractors both need.
stores.address: Stand 6, Tsumeb Industrial Yard, Independence Avenue
stores.return_policy: 14 days on unused PPE.
stores.delivery_promise: Same-day delivery to the mine contractors in Tsumeb.

stores.name: Tsumeb Copper Town Hub
stores.tagline: The lake town, reopened
stores.story: Tsumeb is a lake town with a mining history and a new chapter. The hub serves the lake camps, the local trade and the road north to the Zambezi.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on goods in original condition unless marked final sale.
stores.delivery_promise: Orders placed before 12:00 leave Tsumeb the same working day.

stores.name: Zambezi Auto Spares
stores.tagline: Spares for the road and the lake
stores.story: Auto spares and boat hardware, run by a family that services both the trucks on the tarmac and the boats on the lake.
stores.return_policy: 14 days on unused parts.
stores.delivery_promise: Fitted while you wait, or delivered the same afternoon.

reviews.author: Mpho K.
reviews.body: The veg was actually on the shelf when they said it was. That is more than I can say for most places.

reviews.author: Tshepo A.
reviews.body: Naledi marked the avocados down because they were going off. Honest shop.

reviews.author: Kagiso
reviews.body: Deep stock on the staples. I never leave empty handed anymore.

reviews.author: Lerato M.
reviews.body: They held my maize meal aside when I was delayed by traffic. No argument.

reviews.author: Katlego
reviews.body: Koeksisters still warm when the rider arrived. That never happens.

reviews.author: Dineo S.
reviews.body: The koeksisters are worth the early alarm. And the pies are properly filled.

reviews.author: Bongani
reviews.body: Mosi at half the price of Sandton and it was cold. Come here.

reviews.author: Refilwe
reviews.body: Great range. Wish they had more of the craft stuff.

reviews.author: Mpho K.
reviews.body: Joseph spent twenty minutes helping me choose a pot for induction. I would have bought the wrong one.

reviews.author: Nomvula
reviews.body: Refill is cheaper than the box and they bring it to the door.

reviews.author: Ramehlo
reviews.body: Ramehlo read my skin properly and did not try to sell me the expensive thing.

reviews.author: Kealeboga P.
reviews.body: The braiding is worth every minute. She uses her own products on me.

reviews.author: Molefe T.
reviews.body: Sent a photo of the fitting at 8pm, replied at 8:05 with the right part. Rare.

reviews.author: Mamabolo
reviews.body: They turned my hem while I waited. The print is beautiful.

reviews.author: Amogelang
reviews.body: Made to measure, and the price was better than the shop in the mall.

reviews.author: Mpho K.
reviews.body: Resoled my old boots instead of selling me new ones. Respect.

reviews.author: Itumeleng
reviews.body: Good backpack for the price and they adjusted the strap at the counter.

reviews.author: Segolebe
reviews.body: Karabo sized my ring while I waited and the gold rate was fair.

reviews.author: Boitumelo
reviews.body: Thabang fixed my screen in two hours and it is still perfect.

reviews.author: Tshepo
reviews.body: They transferred all my data onto the new phone in front of me.

reviews.author: Katlego
reviews.body: They let me play my own music in the listening room. I bought the soundbar there.

reviews.author: Lameck
reviews.body: Setho built my machine and it still runs cool after a year of gaming.

reviews.author: Tumelo
reviews.body: Diagnosed my laptop in front of me instead of just taking it away.

reviews.author: Lesego
reviews.body: Ordered a cable at 7pm, it was on my desk by 8. Saved me a trip.

reviews.author: Kagiso
reviews.body: Always has the exact adapter I need. That is the whole business.

reviews.author: Refilwe
reviews.body: Collected from three different shops in one basket, one trip. That is the point.

reviews.author: Mpho K.
reviews.body: Amos sorted out a return that the shop had forgotten about. Good man.
